title: MyPage
subtitle: Homepage Builder
error_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
users_hint: Each user gets their own password-protected file area at /bereich. The username is the email address. If a mail server is configured, the user automatically receives their credentials by email.
user_pw_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
user_pw_mailed: Password changed — user was notified by email
user_created_mailed: User created — credentials sent by email
user_delete_confirm: Really delete user {email} and all their files?
user_smtp_off: Welcome email: no mail server configured
member_no_files: No files yet — upload your first one.
member_err_quota: Storage limit reached — the file was not saved.
blog_hint: Posts appear under /blog, the latest three also on the homepage. Markdown is supported.
import_readme: Use the repos' README as detail text
export_hint: Downloads the whole site as a static HTML package (German) — e.g. for GitHub Pages. Contact form and language switcher are disabled in the export.
sensors_hint: The add-on automatically reports sensor.mypage_views_total, sensor.mypage_visitors_total, sensor.mypage_views_today and sensor.mypage_visitors_today to Home Assistant (every 2 minutes).
nf_text: The requested page does not exist (anymore).
skills_hint: Shown as chips on the page. Emojis work too: 🐍 Python
long_hint: With a detail text or gallery the project gets its own subpage, linked from the card.
contact_telegram_hint: Tip: get notified about new messages via Telegram (bot token + chat ID) or email (SMTP) — configurable in the add-on options.
contact_success: Thanks! Your message has been sent.
contact_error: Sending failed. Please try again later.
contact_rate_limited: Too many messages — please try again later.
messages_hint: Messages from the public page's contact form (up to 200 are kept).
maintenance_hint: Takes the public page offline and shows a notice instead (HTTP 503). The admin panel stays available.
maintenance_default: This site is currently under maintenance. Please check back later.
backup_hint: Saves content, statistics, messages and all uploaded images as a ZIP.
confirm_restore: Restore backup? Existing content will be overwritten.
legal_hint_impressum: Required in Germany for non-private sites (§5 DDG). Generate a template, e.g. with the e-recht24.de imprint generator, and paste it here.
legal_hint_privacy: Required by Art. 13 GDPR — among other things because of the visitor log (IP addresses). Generate a template, e.g. with datenschutz-generator.de (free for individuals), and paste it here.
legal_footer_hint: Once text is entered, the links appear automatically in the footer of the public page (/impressum and /datenschutz). Empty pages are not linked.
avatar_hint: Recommended: square image, at least 256×256 px.
error_select: Please select at least one repo.
no_projects_admin: No projects yet — create one or import from GitHub.
preview_hint: The public page runs on port 17760 — open it in a new tab to see your changes.
